class.name: NNCustomPropertyConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores directly from a numeric property on any scene node.
class.description: Reads [member property_name] from [member node_with_property], normalizes it by dividing by [member property_max_value], and optionally passes the result through [member activation_curve]. Use this when you want to score an existing node property (such as a character's [code]health[/code] or [code]ammo[/code]) without adding a separate [NNSensor] or writing glue code. If several considerations share the same value, prefer a sensor instead.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Evaluates [member activation_curve] at [param input_value], or returns [code]0.0[/code] if no curve is assigned.

members.member: Optional [Curve] or [NNResponseCurve] applied to the normalized property value. If unset, the normalized value is used directly.
Node to read [member property_name] from. Scores [code]0.0[/code] if unset.
Maximum expected value used to normalize the property into [code]0..1[/code]. Must be finite and non-zero.
Name of the numeric property to read from [member node_with_property].
